title: VRPAgent: LLM-Driven Discovery of Heuristic Operators for Vehicle Routing Problems
abstract: arXiv:2510.07073v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Designing high-performing heuristics for vehicle routing problems (VRPs) is a complex task that requires both intuition and deep domain knowledge. Large language model (LLM)-based code generation has recently shown promise across many domains, but it still falls short of producing heuristics that rival those crafted by human experts. In this paper, we propose VRPAgent, a framework for VRPs that integrates LLM-generated components into a metaheuristic and refines them through a novel genetic search. By using the LLM to generate problem-specific operators, embedded within a shared metaheuristic framework for VRPs, VRPAgent keeps tasks manageable, guarantees correctness, and still enables the discovery of novel and powerful strategies. translated_title: VRPAgent：基于大语言模型驱动的车辆路径问题启发式算子发现方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.07073v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：为车辆路径问题（VRP）设计高性能启发式算法是一项复杂的任务，既需要直觉也需要深入的领域知识。基于大语言模型（LLM）的代码生成最近在许多领域展现出潜力，但在生成能与人类专家精心设计的启发式算法相媲美的算法方面仍有不足。在本文中，我们提出了VRPAgent，这是一个针对车辆路径问题的框架，它将LLM生成的组件集成到元启发式算法中，并通过一种新颖的遗传搜索对其进行优化。通过利用LLM生成针对特定问题的算子，并将其嵌入到面向车辆路径问题的共享元启发式框架中，VRPAgent使任务保持可管理性，保证了正确性，同时仍能发现新颖而强大的策略。在多个车辆路径问题上，包括带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP）、带时间窗的车辆路径问题（VRPTW）以及带收益收集的车辆路径问题（PC-VRP），我们的方法所发现的启发式算子优于手工设计的方法和近期的学习方法。
tldr: 提出VRPAgent框架，将LLM生成的特定问题算子嵌入共享元启发式框架并通过遗传搜索优化，在多种车辆路径问题上发现的启发式算子超越了人工设计和学习方法。
en_tdlr: VRPAgent integrates LLM-generated problem-specific operators into a shared metaheuristic framework refined through genetic search, discovering heuristic operators that outperform handcrafted and learning-based methods across multiple vehicle routing problems.
